name: Base Explosive Material
description: Volatile. Ignites for 5 damage to everything within 5 ft; doesn't enlarge or stack with other blasts (the higher damage applies). If carried and you roll a natural 1 on any physical activity, it explodes. Explodes on contact with fire; fails when damp.

name: Common Explosive Material
description: Only set off by another explosion or a blasting cap. 5 damage within 5 ft, same non-stacking rule. Explodes on contact with fire; fails when damp.

name: Water-Proofing
description: Explosive materials don't fail when damp (still won't go off when submerged).

name: Blasting Cap
description: Tiny detonator, lit by a fuse. 1 damage to someone next to it; sets off adjacent explosive material.

name: Basic Squib
description: 5 damage when detonated; short built-in fuse (seconds).

name: Gunpowder Line (50 ft)
description: Price ½ d. Burns 5 ft per turn; broken by tier 3 wind, water or a brushing foot.

name: Basic Fuse (50 ft)
description: Burns 10 ft per turn; put out by water, cutting or snuffing (1 AP); won't burn underwater.

name: Underwater Fuse (50 ft)
description: Burns 10 ft per turn, insulated; only stopped by cutting. +3 d per 50 ft for 20 ft per turn.

name: Fast Fuse (50 ft)
description: Burns 20 ft per turn; put out by water, cutting or snuffing (1 AP); not underwater.

name: Detonator Cord (50 ft)
description: Burns 25 miles per turn (effectively instant); not underwater.

name: Electrical Fuze (50 ft)
description: Instant over any distance; works underwater.

name: Flint & Steel
description: Price ¼ d. 3 AP to light something.

name: Matches (pack of 10)
description: 2 AP to light a fuse; a single match costs ⅛ d.

name: Lighter
description: 1 AP to light a fuse; steady small flame.

name: Trench Lighter
description: 1 AP; stays lit in everything below tier 4 rain or wind.

name: Flameless Lighter
description: 1 AP; lights fuses without an open flame.

name: Explosive (crafted)
description: Light, thrown. Activate 1 AP, throw 2 AP; explodes at the start of your next turn. 10 damage per marque (mQ I–IV 10/20/30/40) in the target space and all adjacent spaces; Dexterity resist (1 AP reflexive). Market price mQ I–IV 5/25/125/625 pr.

name: Firebomb (crafted)
description: Light, thrown; lands in the target space even on a miss. Activate 1 AP, throw 2 AP. 3 damage per marque (3/6/9/12) to the target space and all adjacent spaces; burns until the end of the activator's next turn and hurts anyone who enters or ends their turn there. Market price mQ I–IV 3/15/75/375 pr.

name: Squib (crafted)
description: Light, thrown; detonates within seconds. Activate 1 AP, throw 2 AP. 5 damage per marque (5/10/15/20) to the target only; normal Evade, soakable. Marque from Alchemy. Market price mQ I–IV 1/5/25/125 pr.
